3905.title: Repository paths resolved from a nested workspace
3905.rootCauseOneLine: Repository-relative diff paths are interpreted from the nested workspace, producing empty patches and doubled disk-context paths.
3905.proposedFix: Resolve diff paths and context against an explicit repository root while preserving file-read containment.
3905.caveats: Production backend reproduction only; exact desktop visuals were not exercised. Complete fix crosses subsystem boundaries, so no automatic PR.
